<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_player_pos():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 24:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rows), min(cols))
    return None

pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"At {pos}")

# Test DOWN from [26,14]
result = action(['DOWN'])
new_pos = get_player_pos()
print(f"DOWN: {pos} -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != pos}")

if new_pos != pos:
    pos = new_pos
    # Continue DOWN
    result = action(['DOWN'])
    new_pos = get_player_pos()
    print(f"DOWN: {pos} -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != pos}")
    
    if new_pos != pos:
        pos = new_pos
        result = action(['DOWN'])
        new_pos = get_player_pos()
        print(f"DOWN: {pos} -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != pos}")
        
        if new_pos != pos:
            pos = new_pos
            result = action(['DOWN'])
            new_pos = get_player_pos()
            print(f"DOWN: {pos} -> {new_pos}, moved={new_pos != pos}")
</parameter>
</function>
